Retrieves the list of process-based applications
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/process-based-apps

Retrieves the list of process-based applications.

Request

QUERY PARAMETERS

int32

Specifies the page size.

The search string used to match against the policies.
